messages.content: Write a Python class `TokenBucket` that implements a token bucket rate limiter. Constructor: TokenBucket(capacity, refill_rate) where capacity is max tokens and refill_rate is tokens per second. Methods: allow(n=1) -> bool (tries to consume n tokens, returns True if enough, False if not), tokens() -> float (current available tokens, refilled based on elapsed time). Use the time module. Tokens refill continuously based on time elapsed. Output only the code.
